lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance clusters are arranged in three distinct horizontal rows along the posterior flank, forming a rectangular lattice. Centroids in the mid-flank region are difficult to isolate due to high-intensity surface caustics.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like structure most visible in the posterior third of the animal.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the mid-flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side. A secondary ridge is partially visible superior to the primary one.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin displays a high-density cluster of smaller spots that do not conform to the grid-like alignment seen on the main flank.
